title: Evaluation of an output layer
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let an output layer be specified by a finite set of input indices among $m$ indices, choose an AND or OR gate, and assign a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube to each input. Evaluating this output layer as a function gives the result of applying the chosen gate to those input functions at the selected indices.
hypotheses_covered: the output layer's inputs form a finite subset of the $m$ indices
the gate is either AND or OR
each of the $m$ inputs is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
